Principal Backend Architect (contract)

Company: Kestrel Cloud

We are hiring a principal architect to lead our multi-region platform redesign.

- Distributed systems design, event-driven architecture at scale
- Python/Go; Kafka, Kubernetes, Terraform
- You will be the final technical authority on the platform team

Engagement: B2B contractor, 30-40 h/week
Rate: $4,500 - $6,000 per month
Remote: worldwide, 6h overlap with UTC
Application: talent@kestrelcloud.example

evidence_spans.exclusivity: you will be the final technical authority

notes: Overqualification edge case: principal-level posting vs senior IC profile -> gap >= 2 -> handson_focus mode, format-rationale sentence in cover letter. Rate max $6,000 is above ceiling but min $4,500 is in band -> score penalty, not hard reject.
